currentWork.title: AN15 intelligence v2 measured-learning baseline
currentWork.releaseStatus: AN15A-C lifecycle hardening is merged. Executable CI passes. Production forecasts are unchanged; eligible exact 24h forecast/outcome pairs can now accumulate automatically for evaluation.
scope: Production listForecasts output is observed without changing forecast values.
Only complete, non-lower-bound machine/product forecasts are snapshotted as 24h evaluation candidates.
Only later confirmed sales reports whose previousClearAt exactly equals forecast asOf and whose occurredAt exactly equals targetAt are scored.
Sold-out outcomes are marked censored and excluded from exact-learning metrics.
Weekday/month/season are derived deterministically from target time; weather and holiday remain unknown unless explicitly sourced.
AN15C incremental evaluation now compares context adjustment against the AN15B-calibrated or sparse-fallback baseline.
AN15B/C/D/D2/E/F numeric or optimization promotion remains disabled until real held-out evidence supports it.
AN15G2 Gemini explanation production verification remains independent and may still be externally Vercel-rate-limited.
OPS10C remains withdrawn; preserve existing Today nearest-machine ordering.
nextActions: Accumulate real exact scored samples without changing production numeric decisions.
Evaluate AN15B then AN15C then any pooling increment with no-lookahead held-out evidence.
Promote only a bounded/versioned/reversible correction after sample/confidence and improvement gates pass.
Verify /api/explain against Gemini when Vercel deployment availability permits.

unresolved: Numeric learning promotion requires sufficient real exact scored samples and held-out improvement evidence.
Gemini /api/explain production verification may remain blocked by external Vercel deployment rate limits.
